# Contractor Guardians

> Contractor Guardians is a home services ecosystem that protects homeowners and empowers contractors with verified professionals, digital contracts, escrow payments, and project monitoring. Connecting homeowners, contractors, insurance agents, real estate professionals, and investors.

## About

Contractor Guardians is a platform built to bring trust and transparency to the home improvement industry. Homeowners get access to verified, vetted contractors. Contractors get tools to grow their business, manage projects, and get paid securely. The platform also serves insurance agents, real estate professionals, and investors.

- [Home](https://contractorguardians.com)
- [For Homeowners](https://contractorguardians.com/homeowners)
- [For Contractors](https://contractorguardians.com/contractors)
- [For Insurance Agents](https://contractorguardians.com/insurance)
- [For Real Estate Professionals](https://contractorguardians.com/realestate)
- [For Investors](https://contractorguardians.com/investor)
- [Affiliates](https://contractorguardians.com/affiliates)
- [Trade School](https://contractorguardians.com/tradeschool)
- [About](https://contractorguardians.com/about)
- [Contact](https://contractorguardians.com/contact)

## Who We Serve

- **Homeowners** — Find and hire verified, vetted contractors for home improvement projects. Digital contracts and escrow payment protection on every job.
- **Contractors** — Get verified, grow your client base, manage projects digitally, and get paid securely through escrow.
- **Insurance Agents** — Connect with contractors and homeowners in the home services ecosystem.
- **Real Estate Professionals** — Access a network of verified contractors for pre-sale repairs, renovations, and property management needs.
- **Investors** — Connect with vetted contractors for investment property work and renovations.
- **Affiliates** — Partner with Contractor Guardians to grow your business.

## Key Features

- **Contractor Verification** — All contractors on the platform are vetted and verified before being listed.
- **Digital Contracts** — Every project uses a digital contract to protect both parties.
- **Escrow Payments** — Payments are held in escrow and released on project milestones — homeowners don't pay until work is done as agreed.
- **Project Monitoring** — Track progress, communication, and milestones in one place.
- **Trade School** — Training and certification resources for contractors looking to grow their skills.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Contractor Guardians?**
Contractor Guardians is a platform that connects homeowners with verified contractors using digital contracts, escrow payment protection, and project monitoring to ensure every job goes smoothly.

**How does Contractor Guardians protect homeowners?**
Every contractor on the platform is verified and vetted. Projects use digital contracts and escrow payments — your money is held until the work is completed as agreed. You also get project monitoring to track progress.

**How does Contractor Guardians help contractors?**
Contractors get a verified profile that builds trust with homeowners, tools to manage projects digitally, and secure escrow-based payment so they get paid reliably on completion of agreed milestones.

**Is Contractor Guardians free for homeowners?**
Visit contractorguardians.com/homeowners or contact info@contractorguardians.com for current pricing details.

**How do I find a verified contractor?**
Go to contractorguardians.com/homeowners to search for verified contractors in your area.

**How do contractors get verified?**
Contractors apply and go through a vetting process before being listed on the platform. Visit contractorguardians.com/contractors for details on the verification process.
